name: Soldier's Bible
title: Soldier's Bible
sub: For all Soldiers, Army, Marine Corps, Navy, Air Force, Space Force, Coast Guard, and Veterans

hook.h2: He called him a mighty warrior while he was hiding
hook.text: The messenger of our Father appeared to him and said, "Our Father is with you, mighty warrior."
father: "Our Father is with you, mighty warrior."
hook.note: Gideon was threshing wheat down in a winepress to keep it out of sight of the enemy — the least warlike posture in the book — and that is the moment he gets the title. Our Father named him for what He saw in him, not for anything on his record. Every soldier knows the difference between what a jacket says about a man and what he is; this is our Father settling it, in BLUE, before Gideon had done a thing.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.
Gideon was hiding in a winepress when our Father greeted him as a mighty warrior, and told him to go in the strength he already had. He was named for what our Father saw, not for what he had done.

You stand watch so others can sleep. You are used to being addressed by rank, by role, and by what you last accomplished. Your Father calls you by what He sees in you, and He does it first — before the deployment, before the record, before you have proven anything to anyone.
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries their name. Six by nine, hardcover, full color throughout.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — complete, 66 books and 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. long.h: You Stand Watch So Others Can Sleep. Your Father Calls You By What He Sees In You.
body: Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress, out of sight of the enemy, when the angel of the Father greeted him with a name he had not earned yet. "Our Father is with you, mighty warrior." — Judges 6:12
Your Father named him mighty before he had done anything mighty. He sees you the same way. It is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so you hear Him for yourself.

Scripture is not squeamish about this life. It is full of soldiers, garrisons, night watches, oaths, orders, fear before a fight and the long quiet afterward, and it does not hand any of them an easy answer. What it hands you is a Father who speaks into exactly that — and in this edition, you can see which of those words are His.

long.h: A Three Color Bible: Red Letter, Blue Letter, Purple Letter
body: The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation. His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored. Our Father speaks 125,457 words here. The Son speaks 39,936. More than one word in four of this Bible is a divine person speaking.
Narration stays black, and so does every human voice in the story. When a king or a commander invokes His name to justify something, you can see for yourself whether our Father said it.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6). This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: God as Father, Abba Father, your Heavenly Father — and you, His beloved child.

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.
He is not a commanding officer who has read your file and found it wanting. He is your Father, and He delights in you.

faq.q: Is this only for the Army?
faq.a: No — it is for all soldiers: Army, Marine Corps, Navy, Air Force, Space Force, Coast Guard, and veterans. "Soldier" is used the way Scripture uses it, for anyone who stands a watch.

faq.q: What makes the Soldier's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — bound and opened for someone in uniform. The cover and the opening pages are what change: a word about the Father who named Gideon a mighty warrior while he was still hiding, a prayer to pray, and passages on intimacy, identity and inheritance chosen for a soldier. From Genesis 1:1 onward the text is identical to every other edition.

faq.q: Is it built to deploy with?
faq.a: Honestly: it is a 6 x 9 hardcover of 876 pages, a full Bible, and it is heavy. It is made to be the copy on the shelf at home, in the barracks room, or handed over at a commissioning or a retirement with a name on the presentation page. For the field, read it free on a phone at fathersheartbible.com/read, or listen to it in English — the same translation, no signal cost to the print copy waiting for you.

faq.q: Does it deal with what combat does to a person?
faq.a: Scripture does, and this translation does not soften it. The night watches, the fear, the guilt, the grief and the long quiet afterward are all in there, spoken by people who lived them. What Divine Voice Color adds is the ability to see, on the page, which words in the middle of all that are our Father's own. If anxiety, trauma or PTSD is the weight you are carrying, the Peace Bible is the same complete translation opened for that.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a veteran?
faq.a: It is made for it — a complete hardcover Bible with a dust jacket and a presentation page for a name and a date. Order direct and shipping is free.
